comparison.objective: Perform a three-step serial dilution with a transfer pipette.
comparison.physical_skill: Squeeze/release liquid transfer, ordered cup selection and contamination avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: Three target concentrations in order, no back-contamination or spill, empty pipette returned and released.
comparison.reason: Tests liquid-handling sequence and contamination control rather than rigid contact impact, fracture and metal-fragment containment.
